hypothesis: Lower-dimensional regularized probability learning, recency weighting and a score-dependent selected-value correction may improve on the previously poor HGB probability predictions and positive-score calibration. None is assumed effective before evaluation.
contract: Unchanged v9 fixed6% protective stop,+5% cent-rounded TP,14 inclusive calendar days. Premarket09:25:30 decision; first RTH Open strictly after30-second latency (09:30). Adverse gaps,stop-first ambiguous bars,full costs,T+1,dividends,one settled-cash position and cross-month MTM. No new learned exit or month-dependent rule.
factors: direction=+1SOXL/-1SOXS. SOXX1/5/20day returns divided by prior20day SOXX daily volatility times sqrt(horizon),signed by direction; QQQ5day analog; current SOXX and fixed-panel mean premarket returns divided by prior SOXX volatility and signed; six normalized return fields clipped[-5,5]. Own ETF log prior20day volatility. Volatility floor1e-4. All scaler moments fit on eligible training rows only.
training: Each00:00ET use ALL prior parent entry dates whose BOTH ETF full14day windows are complete and available strictly before cutoff. Minimum120 distinct dates. Recency weights2^(-age_rank/126) over eligible date rank,normalize to sum=number of dates; each ETF receives half its parent weight. Uniform arm has weight1perdate. No early-winner release; no future or current-day targets. Later raw price history is excluded from the engine before labeling.
classifier: StandardScaler(weighted) then LogisticRegression(C=.1,lbfgs,max_iter2000,tol1e-10,defaultL2,no class weighting),pooled2ETF directions. One-class training falls back to the ETF historical frequency. No hyperparameter search. Conditional target/non-target net log payoff are ETF-specific weighted empirical means,not separate flexible models. Raw score=p*mean_target_log_return+(1-p)*mean_non_target_log_return.
model_controls: Full arm uses original25 v9 entry features. Ridge factor arm uses StandardScaler and Ridge(alpha100,svd) for net log payoff. Mean arm uses ETF-specific weighted net log payoff; its reported p is merely historical frequency. No future validation or case month changes these definitions.
selected_value_calibration: For each model save the as-issued raw scores and raw higher-score ETF before observing outcomes. Latest120 mature prior raw TOP choices,min60. Standardize their scalar raw scores using their own past mean and population standard deviation; regress realized net log returns with intercept=mean(y),slope=sum(z*(y-mean(y)))/(sum(z*z)+20); constrain slope>=0 to preserve rank interpretation. Constant raw scores use scale1 and slope0. Predict current chosen value with that frozen daily map. It calibrates chosen contract value,not probability or actual capital return. Negative empirical slope is retained in diagnostics even when operative slope=0.
calibration_controls: Same raw primary forecast and exactly same120/min60 mature top dates; offset control adds mean(y-x),raw control leaves score unchanged. Both wait for same calibration readiness to isolate map form. All model actions require positive adjusted top value;tiesSOXL. Score extrapolation is reported,not secretly filtered.
stress: Double fees/slippage with same primary entry actions,own stress fills and barriers;no stressed fitting.
development_screen: As in v11/v12,do not launch a new case replay unless primary complete-coverage development ledger has all4months>=0,arithmeticmean>=10%,and>=10completed actual trades. This research screen does not replace the original5/7/9 acceptance;diagnostic controls cannot rescue a failed primary after results.
acceptance: Original5/7/9 net capital month arithmetic mean>=10%;allMay-Sep months nonnegative;complete coverage. Exposed development data are not independent future evidence. Historical pass would not guarantee future lossless months.
diagnostics: Brier versus same-date weighted empirical frequencies;log payoff error;selected positive-score realized outcomes;negative calibration slopes and extrapolations;route-specific actual trades and monthly NAV. Paired daily log capital differences use10-session circular block bootstrap5000replicates seed707. Do not treat correlated ETF candidates or overlapping windows as independent trades.
